name: Melon
description:
Explore a variety of Melon charts, get personalized music recommendations just for you, and discover your listening habits. All in one place. You can even play songs directly in the Melon app.
 • Browse detailed information about artists, albums, and tracks.
 • Search for songs and playlists using Melon charts and trending keywords.
 • Enjoy personalized recommendations based on the songs you love and listen to most. The service is currently available in Korean only.
 An English version is scheduled to be made available within this year, with an anticipated release in October.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Melon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Melon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.melon.com/mcp/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Melon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Melon lists 26 MCP tools, including chart_get, detail_get_playlist_songs, detail_get_content, detail_get_artist_songs, detail_get_artist_albums, detail_get_musicstory, detail_get_content_detail_url, genre_get_main_genres, genre_get_sub_genres, genre_get_content, mymusic_get_recent_content, and mymusic_get_playlists.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Melon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Melon in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Melon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Melon is developed by Kakao Entertainment. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
